The column scans show alternating dirt and asphalt runs, such as x=64 rows 50-61 L=57 navy and x=128 rows 50-62 dirt, with no front-edge line or eave shadow. styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate has only 11 distinct colours in total and 5 visible tones per tile, which is above the grass reference (3) and below the paving reference (7). Large areas of the road (the big block at right and the road arms) read as near-flat navy with only tiny speckle. The layout has crossroads and dead ends, but the pieces look fragmented, with isolated blobs. The candidate is clearly simpler than Beodeul's 5-6 step ramps and per-element shading, so it falls short of the standard.
